text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the
campus, I
notice an unnatural pile of
leaves in my path.
Whaaat?! Why'd ya dodge my pitfall?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! My prized pitfall! It got clowned
on
before... but still!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Scold me all ya want, but I'm not
gonna
stop! Imma keep makin' pitfalls!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Is that right? You really gotta reflect
on your
actions. But... I guess you're not
all that bad
compared to Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She made the perfect pitfall in a carrot
patch and
caused all kinds of trouble for
students comin' to
sneak a snack.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Even I can find the pitfalls you make, so I guess that makes ya some kinda small fry compared to her!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grahhh! Imma totally make a pitfall
that's way
better than Golshi's! And it's
gonna catch all of
you, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she actually made this
pitfall to keep
students from eating the
carrots, not just to cause
mischief... She
just doesn't realize that herself.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dang it! How can people tell?! I hid it
perfectly
this time! With leaves!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: O-oh! I mean, of course I knew that!
choice_data_list: Actually, that felt kind of unnatural, you know.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You got a pretty keen eye on ya. Imma
make ya
my minion, so help me out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since I don't have anything pressing to
do, I
decide to give her a hand. But
then...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: How's that?! I put leaves all over this time, not just around the hole, so it looks real natural-like!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyuh?! The wind blew 'em all away?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I used rocks to weigh everythin' down
this time,
so it's not gonna blow away
again! Now I just
gotta pour some water
in there to cushion the—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Why?! Won't it stay in there like a
pool?!
choice_data_list: The water's going to soak into the ground, you know?
The water will soak into the ground, you know?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... I spread a tarp... inside the hole... and filled the... hole with... water... Now if someone steps onto it, like so—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-HUH?! Now you can't even fall in?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WAHHHHH! I have to remake it again?! I'm pooped! Exhausted! TIRED!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
NUH-UH! No matter how tough my prey,
these
fangs o'mine ain't gonna crack!
choice_data_list: Let's rest for now and tackle it tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's my rule... as a hunter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her unwavering drive is magnificent, but
I'm
worried about her level of fatigue.
What should I
say to her?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No! Nuh-uh! Shut it! You're my minion, so you gotta listen to what I say!
choice_data_list: Just leave the rest to your lackey.
Let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! ...Actually, a hero show I watched
the other
day had the leader sitting in
their chair the whole
time...
choice_data_list: Leaving things to your underlings is part of a boss's job.
Leaving things to your underlings is part of a boss's job, too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
'Kay, sure! Put your back into it! Your
almighty
leader'll be watchin' ya from
right over here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Shinko Windy resting, I get the job
done
smoothly and efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're done, eh?! Lookin' good!
But the
most important thing is that it
actually works...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I hear footsteps... Someone's definitely
comin' for
a snack! Let's see if yer pitfall
does the job!

Hm? She's not here either...
Wait—GAHHH?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Nice! We caught someone! You
deserve
some praise, minion!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! Time to confirm the catch and
revel in
our success!
choice_data_list: More importantly, we need to check on the one who fell...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ha. Ha... I was worried I'd pushed ya too
far, but
looks like you made a real nice
pitfall here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm gonna have to "reward" ya
handsomely
for this one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Shinko Windy's effective
pitfall earns
her praise, it also catches
the innocent Hishi
Amazon... and results
in another scolding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should respect her wishes here. But if
she looks
like she's pushing herself too
hard, I'll step in to
help. She won't get
hurt that way.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Niiice! And that's what makes ya my
trusty minion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I keep working, following her
instructions and
offering occasional
advice on crafting pitfalls,
until...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: IT'S FINISHED! Yes, yes, yes! We did it!

Hahaha! Well? Bet you get a totally
different
sense of achievement
compared to pranking,
right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama! Uh-huh, totally different! I
worked so
hard, thinkin' 'bout how to
catch lotsa prey, and I
tweaked it a
bunch...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And now, the prank potential's
skyrocketed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... the prank potential's sk—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! Sure, it's a pitfall, but you're
using it to
stop students from stealing
carrots from the field!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's the idea, right? Using a prank to
help
others... Somethin' like that?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What the heck're ya talkin' 'bout?
Pranks don't
have nothin' to do with
helpin' people!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so Shinko Windy remains a
prankster,
through and through.
